Simple and affordable electricity plans for your home

Residential electricity plans

Affordable plans for your home

We believe change begins at home. So we’re bringing our affordable electricity plans to homes across Singapore soon. Our residential plans will also include The Flo Commitment, so you can rest assured you’re supporting global renewable energy generation.
Register your interest now!

Recognised by the best

Flo is an award-winning energy company trusted across the region. We've been recognised by Statista as one of Singapore's Fast-Growing Companies 2026 and a 2025 Company of Good for our renewable solutions.

Save on sustainability

Keep costs low and go green with plans designed for real homes and real needs. From solar options to more products coming soon, everything is easily managed through our FlowSmart Dashboard.

Reliable supply

Enjoy a stable, uninterrupted electricity supply. Switching to Flo is seamless — there’s no disruption to your power at home.

Trusted by thousands

Join thousands of customers across Singapore who are choosing Flo as part of the move towards a more sustainable energy future.

The Flo Commitment

We match 100% of your electricity usage with regional Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) and redeem them on your behalf. These certificates comply with the Singapore Standard 673, enabling you to confidently support renewable energy generation across the region.

Be the first to know

Fill in the form to let us know you’re interested in our residential plans. We’ll be in touch when they’re ready!
